name: Disney
description: Family-friendly. Princesses, villains, Pixar, theme parks and sing-alongs.

prompts.text: The real reason the Genie only grants three wishes: ____.
Cinderella lost a glass slipper, but she also left behind ____.
What's really inside Mary Poppins' bag?
Coming soon to the theme park: ____: The Ride.

What did the Magic Mirror say when the Queen asked one too many times?
Hakuna Matata means no worries, except for ____.

Elsa finally let it go, but she's still holding on to ____.

Dory forgot everything except ____.

Waiting two hours for a 90-second ride.
A churro the length of my arm.
Mickey ears that light up and play music.
A talking teapot with strong opinions.

Singing my feelings to a woodland creature.

Crying at the movie again, on purpose.

Being chosen by a magical object.
An inspiring speech that goes on way too long.
